method: Run scripts/benchmark-review-speed.mjs --pgn games.pgn --check. Each game is reviewed at depth 16 by one Stockfish.js 19.0.1 single-threaded engine move by move, as ChessBot 3.7 did, and then by the pooled two-phase review with four engines. With --check, every move is also checked on its own from a cleared search table, and the pooled grade, expected-score loss, and confidence label are compared with it.
machine: MacBook Air, Apple M3 (4 performance and 4 efficiency cores, no fan), 16 GB, macOS 26, Node.js 26. Runs were consecutive, and the fanless machine throttles under sustained load.
games: Three rated 10+0 Lichess games from 2026-10-01 between players rated 1335-1426 (CC0).

isolatedDecisions.note: Pooled results matched one uninterrupted analyzeDecision per move from a cleared table. Against the depth-22 reference: 118/144 exact grades, 142/144 severe vs nonsevere, 0.543 points mean loss error.

rejected.option: Deeper checks from a cleared table without repeating the quick searches
rejected.result: 118/144 exact, 141/144 severe, 0.806 points mean loss error
